# Calculus Formulas

## Derivatives

The derivative of $f(x) = x^n$ is $f'(x) = nx^{n-1}$.

Product rule:

$$(f \cdot g)' = f' \cdot g + f \cdot g'$$

Chain rule:

$$(f \circ g)' = (f' \circ g) \cdot g'$$

## Integrals

$$\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$$

Integration by parts:

$$\int u dv = uv - \int v du$$
